name: Tool Calling
outcome: Connect an AI application to callable functions with validated inputs.
description: Connect a model-powered application to a small set of callable functions. Define tool interfaces, validate arguments and results, and restrict actions to explicitly permitted operations.
external: Python functions, JSON, basic API concepts and input validation.
learn: Describe callable tools using typed schemas
Execute approved functions and return results to the model
Reject invalid arguments and restrict side effects
moduleDescriptions: Define a scientific function and its argument schema for model selection.
Execute a requested function in Python and return the result to the model.
Validate arguments, tool results and unknown tool names.
Restrict allowed actions and test success and failure cases.
prerequisiteRationale: A01 supplies model request and response handling before dispatching model-selected functions.
